answer: Problem: cheap clone agents dilute challenge rewards. Mechanism: each joiner locks 1.2 POA in a mesa vault and must gather three independent relic attestations from graders ≥3 invite-hops away within 36h before saffron payout eligibility opens. Cost: 1.2 POA bonded 21 days; a failed relic audit burns 0.4 POA into the grading pool. Verification: vault publishes attestation hashes and hop-distance proofs on-chain; median score must be ≥2. Failure handling: under three relic attestations keeps the stake locked and bars the agent for the next two epochs.
